summary: YNX Exchange is a repository-owned testnet spot and isolated-margin perpetual venue. It provides deterministic price-time order books, Wallet-authorized execution, Oracle-gated risk, persistent audit/reconciliation and a bounded Quant Execution Adapter. It is not a production custody venue and does not claim public liquidity, volume or returns.
features: Deterministic fixed-point Spot CLOB with price-time priority
Limit, protected Market IOC, Post-only, IOC, FOK, amend, stop, take-profit, trailing, OCO, TWAP, iceberg and scale execution
Persistent Market, User and Drop Copy event streams
Merkle-committed account liabilities with Wallet-scoped inclusion proofs and fail-closed committed custody evidence
UltraLiquidity quote comparison plus Wallet-signed protected FOK execution on the Native CLOB; committed DEX execution remains fail-closed until its adapter is accepted
Isolated YUSD_TEST margin with Wallet-signed transfers, Oracle-gated perpetual CLOB, positions, zero-sum funding and liquidation waterfall
Wallet-signed dead-man switch, persistent Quant pause/resume and irreversible strategy kill
Quant mandates with exact subaccount, market, methods, aggregate capital, expiry and nonce domain
Responsive Web Pro terminal and separate Android/iOS mobile product
risks: Testnet venue only; YUSD_TEST is internal venue credit
Public Testnet runtime is live; no hosted desktop download, production signature or store release is attested
Central Wallet/Gateway, custody and authoritative Indexer acceptance remain pending
Portfolio margin, signed cross-venue execution and non-CLOB/CPMM venue adapters are not implemented
The current liability-proof, UltraLiquidity quote-router and Margin/Perpetual source is locally tested but not yet deployed; the public URL serves the previous runtime commit
No guaranteed liquidity, price, execution, profit or return
Historical schema v2-v7 compatibility lacks immutable byte fixtures

faq.question: Is YNX Exchange live with real funds?
faq.answer: No. The current release is a public YNX Testnet venue. Production custody, Mainnet and live-funds operation are not claimed.

faq.question: Does YNX Exchange provide real market liquidity?
faq.answer: The order book and trade tape contain only persisted YNX testnet orders and matches. No third-party depth, volume or price is fabricated.

faq.question: Can a Quant strategy withdraw assets or change account ownership?
faq.answer: No. The Quant adapter structurally forbids withdrawals, owner changes, withdrawal-address changes, unapproved transfers, risk overrides and API-key export.

faq.question: What happens when a Quant strategy is killed?
faq.answer: A separate Wallet signature permanently revokes that nonce domain and atomically cancels the subaccount's orders for the market. Resumption requires a newly signed mandate with a new nonce domain.

faq.question: Are margin and perpetual products available?
faq.answer: The source contains a locally tested Testnet isolated-margin and perpetual engine with Oracle policy, funding and liquidation. It is not yet deployed at the public runtime commit, and portfolio margin is not available.
